india_context.procedural_notes: Section 12 of Legal Services Authorities Act 1987 grants free legal aid to women, children, members of SC/ST, industrial workmen, and persons whose annual income is below statutory threshold.
india_context.transitional_notes: Consumer disputes below Rs. 50 Lakhs are heard by District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission under Consumer Protection Act 2019.
verification_requirements: Check whether dispute is suitable for pre-litigation settlement through National Lok Adalat.
